content.text:
I have added the requested widgets to your dashboard:

- **Total Refunded KPI** (@widget[total_refunded_kpi]): Displays the total amount of money refunded.
- **Refunds by Claim Type Bar Chart** (@widget[bar_chart_refunded_by_claim]): A horizontal grouped bar chart showing the breakdown of money refunded across different claim types, sorted from highest to lowest.
